verdict.rationale: Wyoming SOS's public pages offer a business entity search by Filing ID or entity name, which returns entity details and PDFs of many filings. They also let users validate a certificate of good standing for free, which gives public visibility into an entity's standing. The evidence never shows tracking of a pending filing, application, or case through processing, so only the entity-record side of the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented status tracking for submitted or pending filings and applications, case status lookup, explicit mention of status fields in search results, and hands-on corroboration of what the search shows.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Search for registered entities using a Filing ID or the entity name... Filings include business entities, trademarks and trade names.
you can search for details about a business entity and obtain PDFs of many of the entity filings!
Print or validate a certificate of good standing for a business entity registered in Wyoming at no cost.
